product_truth_scope: PRODUCT_TRUTH.json holds 22 owner-intent atoms (18 owner-conversation candidates PENDING_OWNER_FREEZE, 4 recorded owner instructions of 2026-10-18). The master's F0_OWNER_INTENT_PRODUCT_TRUTH gate requires 'exact latest owner backend-first direction, original design hashes, signed final scope/decisions and full feature coverage', and VAN-PT-18 defines the chain requirements → Product Truth → DUs. So an owner-facing product requirement needs a Product Truth trace; an engineering correction or directive-governed contract may instead trace to its own authoritative registry.

VAN-CX.reasoning: Consolidation corrective contracts (graded CONSOLIDATION_CORRECTION_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW). They specify how existing intent is met correctly (protection parity, limit-price invariants, expiry propagation, authority) rather than adding owner product intent; every one appears in all three governing registries.

VAN-HVA.reasoning: Owner-directed high-value trading adoptions with source_adoption_ids, all 32 present in the adoption crosswalk and findings disposition. Owner intent is carried by the directive registry; when Product Truth is frozen it should reference that directive (candidate VAN-PT-07, VAN-PT-SO-01) rather than restate each adoption.

VAN-EL.reasoning: Owner-directed experience-learning requirements (source_refs to the 2026-10-18 owner direction) carried by the Rev1.16 registry and contract. Closest atom VAN-PT-SO-02; link is an admission act, not made here.

VAN-JM.reasoning: Owner-directed Jev/model hardening (OWNER_JEV_ARGON_DEEPSEEK_20261018) carried by the Rev1.17 registry and contract. Closest atoms VAN-PT-SO-01/SO-02.

VAN-ML-REQ.reasoning: Forecast requirements (REQUIRED_SOFTWARE_SEPARATE_ECONOMIC_ADMISSION). All 90 source_packet ids are present in the forecast packet crosswalk, but no source_obligation_sha256 re-derives from any string, line or paragraph in the package (checked against the crosswalk and FORECAST_TECHNICAL_SOURCE_REV1_1.md), so obligation-level provenance cannot be verified from the package. Finding for the reviewer, not a Product Truth gap.

VAN-NX-BF.reasoning: Backend-first clauses. F0 names the owner's backend-first direction as part of Product Truth, but none of the 22 atoms states it (VAN-PT-18 describes the engineering chain, not backend-first ordering). Their source_row_sha256 equals sha256 of each clause's own text (18/18), so it is self-referential, not evidence of an external source. Owner action: add or confirm a backend-first atom; nothing is linked here.

Memory privacy, consent and erasure; PT-13 covers authority boundaries but no atom names privacy or erasure. Likely a genuine missing atom.
Owner-editable memory learning goals: no atom covers memory or learning goals. Genuine missing intent trace.

Continuous governed strategy development is self-optimization of the trading scope.

Per-instrument slippage bounds: execution correctness in the trading scope.
Tick quantisation never widens the approved stop: protection integrity.
Entry type executed as requested or refused, never coerced: execution truthfulness.
Recoverable lockouts and owner-signed reset: mode/risk governance and owner authority.
